title: Payment Channels and Returned-Payment Limits for the Home-Site Lease
content:
The Home-Site Lease accepts payment through a fixed list of channels when no restriction applies, a narrower list while a lease is on certified-funds-only status, and applies each payment across open charges in a fixed order. A payment returned unpaid for insufficient funds, a closed account or a stop-payment order carries a returned-payment fee, and returned payments counted over a trailing window can place the lease on certified-funds-only status for a fixed length of time.

### Channels, on every lot class

| Channel | Accepted when no restriction applies | Accepted on certified-funds-only status |
|---|---|---|
| Automatic ACH draft (autopay) | yes | no |
| Resident portal, from a bank account (ACH) | yes | no |
| Resident portal, by debit or credit card | yes | yes |
| Money order at the community office | yes | yes |
| Cashier's check at the community office | yes | yes |
| Personal check at the community office | yes | no |

### Returned payments, partial payments and application order

| Lot class | Returned-payment fee (USD per returned payment) | Returned payments that impose certified-funds-only status | Lookback window for counting them | Length of the restriction, from the triggering return | Partial payment before a nonpayment notice | Partial payment after a nonpayment notice, before cure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 35.00 | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | accepted | not accepted |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 35.00 | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | accepted | not accepted |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 35.00 | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | accepted | not accepted |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 35.00 | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | accepted | not accepted |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 35.00 | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | accepted | not accepted |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 35.00 | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | accepted | not accepted |

**Order in which a payment is applied, on every lot class:** returned-payment fees first, then late fees, then other fees, then the oldest rent and occupant charges.

*Hypothetical application.* A payment of 400.00 on a ledger carrying a 35.00 returned-payment fee, a 40.00 late fee and 600.00 of rent clears the returned-payment fee, then the late fee, and the remaining 325.00 goes to the oldest rent.
